summary: Sun Life Financial filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release dated November 4, 2026, covering the period ended September 30, 2026. Underlying net income was $1,146 million, up 9% year over year, while reported net income fell 29% to $785 million; underlying EPS rose 10% to $2.05 versus reported EPS of $1.40. The common dividend increased to $1.00 per share from $0.96, and the SLF LICAT ratio stood at 142%. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is a routine quarterly results filing.
